job.title: Entry Level Manager
job.description:
Job Title: Entry-Level Manager

Pay: $50,000 - $60,000

Overview

If you’re an early-career professional who is eager to learn, you take ownership, move fast, and want to lead, this is not just another job. This is a structured, entry-level, path into management.

At Summit Careers, we don’t hire experienced managers off the street, we build them. This role is designed for individuals who want to earn leadership through performance, not tenure. You’ll start by learning the business from the ground up and progress into a leadership role in under a year.

What You’ll Do

From day one, you’ll be actively involved in the core of our business:

  • Recruit, interview, and onboard candidates
  • Manage employees throughout their lifecycle (performance, engagement, retention)
  • Partner with clients to understand hiring needs and deliver talent
  • Submit qualified candidates and manage the hiring process
  • Provide high-level customer service to both clients and employees
  • Support daily branch operations and drive results

This is a fast-paced, people-driven environment where urgency and attention to detail matter.

What We’re Looking For

We’re not looking for average. We’re looking for people who:

  • Bachelor's Degree Required
  • Take ownership and naturally step into leadership roles
  • Thrive with autonomy but stay accountable
  • Are highly detail-oriented and operate with urgency
  • Are competitive and driven, but still team-oriented
  • Build strong relationships and communicate effectively
  • Want a clear path to management and are willing to earn it

Growth Path (Performance-Based)

This is a clearly defined, accelerated path into leadership:

  • Phase 1: Recruiting & Talent Management (~5-8 Months)
  • Phase 2: Account Management (~3-6 Months)
  • Phase 3: Operations Manager (Ideally under 12 months)

Your progression is entirely performance-driven. The faster you produce results, the faster you advance.

Training & Development

We invest heavily in your success:

  • Hands-on, real-world training from experienced leaders
  • Advanced technology and AI tools to accelerate learning
  • Continuous coaching and feedback
  • Clear expectations and measurable goals

You won’t be guessing, you’ll know exactly what it takes to win.

Our Core Values

Everything we do is built around:

  • GSD (Get Stuff Done): No excuses—just results
  • Good People: High integrity, positive attitude
  • Passion for Service: We care deeply about our clients, employees, and our communities
  • Coachable: Always learning, always improving

This is a rare opportunity to fast-track your career into leadership. If you’re looking for a role where your effort directly determines your growth, you’ll fit right in!

Overview

If you’re an early-career professional who is eager to learn, you take ownership, move fast, and want to lead, this is not just another job. This is a structured, entry-level, path into management.

At Summit Careers, we don’t hire experienced managers off the street, we build them. This role is designed for individuals who want to earn leadership through performance, not tenure. You’ll start by learning the business from the ground up and progress into a leadership role in under a year.

job.title: cnc lathe machinist
job.description:
CNC Lathe Machinist

Company
manufacturing leader of precision machined components serving aerospace, defense, oil, gas, microwave technology, industrial and commercial sectors.  Our team is committed to producing the highest quality work using the latest state-of-the-art equipment, technology, and manufacturing methods.  The company, which serves a global market, is located in Agawam, Massachusetts.
The Role
seeking a confident, efficient person to fill this machinist role in our Lathe department.
The focus of this job is on producing high quality, detailed work based on established standards, guidelines and procedures.  Job knowledge and competency is built through structured step by-step training and positive, supportive coaching from management and peers.  Consistent, error free work based on defined regulations and standards are key measures of job performance success. 
The pace for this position will be unassuming and often faster than meets the eye.  Each day is different from the next and will often require switching between tasks based on the priorities within the department.  Attention to detail is a major focus of the job.  As a time factor the work must be done on time, as well as correctly.  This is a position where established guidelines, structure, and established policies must be followed closely.  The successful candidate will be a valued member of our team who performs an important role within the Lathe department, reporting directly to the production manager.
Essential Duties:
  • Demonstrate proficiency in setting up machines independently and following written work instructions.
  • Make quality parts that meet or exceed customer drawings and internal operation sheet requirements.
  • Demonstrate the ability to read and understand customer drawings, and use proper inspection methods to check work using hard gages/plate checks.
  • Follow company procedures and complete all documentation accurately associated with job travelers and SPC charts.
  • Run multiple machines when cycle time reasonable permits while maintain a high level of quality.
Your Qualifications:
  • Proficient in use of CNC Lathe machines (C and Y Axis), using Jaws of various sizes, Collets (16C and 5C).  Ideally experienced with running Okuma and FANUC controls, but not required.
  • Familiar with inspection tools, machinery, and manufacturing procedures.
  • Detail orientated, knowledge of GD&T, machining, computers, quality, safety and team/independent working.
  • Must be dependable, able to work independently with minimal supervision and possess strong work ethics to accomplish tasks accurately and in a timely manner.
